# Appointment Day Checklist

The morning of your TLScontact appointment. Print this page and tick each item before leaving home.

> **The most stressful part is the day itself**, but the appointment itself is short (15–60 minutes depending on group size). Most rejections are caused by missing documents — not by the interview. Bring everything.

---

## Your appointment details

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| Date | `{{APPOINTMENT_DATE}}` |
| Time | `{{APPOINTMENT_TIME}}` |
| Centre | `{{TLS_CENTRE}}` |
| Centre address | `{{CENTRE_ADDRESS}}` |
| Booking ID | `{{TLS_BOOKING_ID}}` |
| Group ID (if applicable) | `{{TLS_GROUP_ID}}` |
| Number of applicants in your group | `{{GROUP_SIZE}}` |

---

## Print before leaving home

Even if you've pre-uploaded to TLScontact, **print physical copies**.

- [ ] **Appointment confirmation** (the email from TLScontact)
- [ ] All documents in [`03-document-checklist.template.md`](./03-document-checklist.template.md), organised in a folder section by section
- [ ] **Two copies of each photo** per applicant (see [`06-photo-spec.template.md`](./06-photo-spec.template.md))
- [ ] Your cover letter (see [`04-cover-letter.template.md`](./04-cover-letter.template.md))

---

## Bring physically (besides documents)

- [ ] **All applicants' original passports** (in the same folder, named-labelled if there are several)
- [ ] **Your original ID** (UK BRP / driving licence / national ID) — for entry to the building
- [ ] **A pen** that works (you'll fill in a couple of forms on the day)
- [ ] **A debit or credit card** for any fees not paid online
- [ ] **A photocopy of your TLScontact booking confirmation** — easier to hand over than re-finding the email
- [ ] **Cash** (not strictly required but a small amount as backup)
- [ ] **Phone charger / power bank** — you may queue for a while

---

## Don't bring (or stash before entering)

Most TLScontact centres restrict:

- ❌ **Large bags or backpacks** — many centres make you store them in lockers at entry
- ❌ **Laptops** — usually not allowed inside
- ❌ **Cameras** (separate from your phone) — usually not allowed
- ❌ **Food / drink** (cafeteria-bought OK once inside in some centres)
- ❌ **Sharp objects** — even nail files / scissors may be flagged at security

Phones are typically allowed but on silent. Check your specific centre's rules — TLScontact's confirmation email usually links to a centre-specific FAQ.

---

## Timing

| Action | When |
|---|---|
| **Arrive at centre** | **15 minutes before** your slot. Earlier than that = you'll wait outside; later than 15 minutes after = you may be turned away. |
| **Get in queue** | There's usually a single entry queue with ID + booking checked at the door |
| **Inside: wait for ticket number to be called** | Typical wait: 10–30 minutes |
| **At the desk: document submission** | 5–15 minutes |
| **Biometrics** (fingerprints + photo) | 5–10 minutes |
| **Fee payment** (if not paid online) | 5 minutes |
| **Leave centre** | Receipt + tracking number in hand |

**Plan to be at the centre for 1–2 hours total** including travel buffer. Group applications (4+ people) can take longer.

---

## At the desk

Your TLScontact officer is checking that:

1. **All documents are present** per the personalised checklist
2. **Names match across documents**
3. **Dates make sense** (insurance covers the trip, accommodation covers the dates, etc.)
4. **Photos meet spec** (they sometimes re-take if the photo isn't perfect)

Be:
- **Calm + organised** — hand documents in the order they ask
- **Concise** when answering — yes/no answers if asked; expand only if pressed
- **Honest** — don't speculate about answers you don't know; "I'm not sure" is fine

**You are not being formally interviewed by the French consulate at TLScontact.** TLScontact is a document-collection partner. The actual decision happens after the documents are forwarded to the consulate.

---

## After biometrics

You'll get:

| Item | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Receipt** (paper) | Proof you submitted the application. Keep this. |
| **Tracking number** | Use it on TLScontact's online tracker to monitor status. |
| **Return method** (passport pickup or courier) | How you'll get your passport back. Confirm what you signed up for. |

| Field | Your answer |
|---|---|
| Date submitted | `{{SUBMIT_DATE}}` |
| Tracking number | `{{TRACKING_NUMBER}}` |
| Return method | `{{RETURN_METHOD}}` (in-person collection / courier) |
| Expected decision date | `{{EXPECTED_DECISION_DATE}}` (typically 7–15 working days) |

---

## After the appointment

| When | What |
|---|---|
| Day of appointment | Save a photo of your receipt to cloud (drive + phone). |
| Days 1–3 | TLScontact tracker says "Documents at TLScontact". This is just transit. |
| Days 3–10 | "Documents at Consulate" — the decision is being made. |
| Days 7–15 typical | "Decision made — passport at TLScontact" — collect it (or courier dispatches). **Don't open the sealed envelope yourself** — the consulate may want the seal intact for entry verification. |

**If your visa is approved**, the visa sticker is placed in your passport. You'll be given the passport at collection (or it arrives by courier).

**If your visa is refused**, you'll get a formal refusal letter explaining the reason. You have the right to appeal within a fixed window (usually 60 days). The refusal letter explains how.

---

## Pre-departure final check (24h before appointment)

- [ ] Confirm appointment date + time + centre on the TLScontact website
- [ ] Print appointment confirmation (paper copy in folder)
- [ ] Charge phone fully
- [ ] Lay out the folder of documents with each applicant's section labelled
- [ ] Each applicant's original passport in the folder, biographic page bookmarked
- [ ] Cover letter signed
- [ ] Photos counted (2 per applicant)
- [ ] Set an alarm to leave home in time for **arrival 15 minutes early**
- [ ] Check transport (TfL strike? roadworks? leave 30 minutes extra buffer)
- [ ] Plan a snack + water for the wait (no food inside; eat before entering)
- [ ] Tell someone at home where you're going + expected return time

---

## Common pitfalls

| Pitfall | How to avoid |
|---|---|
| Arrived more than 15 minutes late | Centres turn late arrivals away. Rebook (small fee). |
| Forgot original passport (brought only a copy) | Original is mandatory. Without it, the appointment is cancelled. |
| Forgot a key document | Re-book is sometimes possible same-day if the centre isn't busy; usually you re-book for another day. **Bring everything** even if you're not sure. |
| Photo got rejected at the desk | Some centres have a photo booth inside (~£8). If yours doesn't, the appointment is paused while you go to a nearby photo shop and return. |
| Brought wrong applicants from group | The group booking specifies who's submitting. Don't bring extra non-group people; they'll have to make their own appointment. |
| Booking ID typo | If the centre staff can't find your booking, show them the email confirmation — they'll re-look up by name + passport number. |

---

**Good luck.** This template family + the [Visa Master extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cpogdllkcpenafboclnidfmmlcnjpbfm) (for getting the appointment in the first place) is the toolkit we wish we'd had on our first application. Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/torlyai/Schengen-master/issues) if you spot something out of date or missing.
